title: Plain lifecycle context segment and profile readers for the steward hook
summary: The steward context hook and @inventarch/workspace-runtime accept lifecycle context segments, events and profiles written under the plain format names (lifecycle-context-segment, lifecycle-context, lifecycle-event, lifecycle-profile with formatVersion 1) alongside the 3.8.1 ia.* literals, while default hook emissions, registered lifecycle profile digests and bound lifecycle retry keys keep exact 3.8.1 shapes and digests while WRITE_PLAIN_NAMES is false.
